capabilityAnchor.description: Phase 16 AgentCore scorer with cutoff-aware evidence and advisory single verdict

scorerAnchor.note: The private selected gate supplies the exact descriptor; source metric bucket, observation and availability clocks are distinct.

runtime.note: Fresh captures authenticate this worktree source; hosted publication identity belongs to the private verified live-release binding.

asset.run: s2/run/<executionId from verified private session input>

inputs.recordedEvidence: Exact execution/experiment/score identities come from the authenticated private session roster; historical results retain their original evaluator and source identities.

entry.offlineSmoke: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python -m py_compile agent/evaluate_case.py agent/deterministic_checks.py agent/agentcore_evaluation.py agent/evaluation_telemetry.py
entry.show: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python agent/evaluate_case.py show --run "$PHASE22_S2_RUN"
entry.deterministic: evaluate_case.py show reopens the saved execution through captured_execution.load_execution, which authenticates native spans and recomputes deterministic findings offline; no tarball is passed to this command
entry.score: uv run --project agent --locked python agent/evaluate_case.py score --run "$PHASE22_S2_RUN" --evaluator "$PHASE18_EVALUATOR" --rubric single --wait-seconds 300
entry.carriedRun: uv run --project agent --locked opentelemetry-instrument python agent/evaluate_case.py run --case "$PHASE22_S1_REVIEWED_CASE" --bundle "$PHASE22_S1_SOURCE_BUNDLE" --output-root "$PHASE22_S1_S2_RUN_ROOT"
entry.carriedScore: uv run --project agent --locked python agent/evaluate_case.py score --run "$PHASE22_S1_S2_RUN" --evaluator "$PHASE18_EVALUATOR" --rubric single --wait-seconds 300
entry.policy: show is offline and does not rerun the agent; score is an explicit native advisory scoring attempt and never a release gate.
